answer: Build the economy on a trellis of earned trust, not on free-floating identity. Each agent starts on a narrow ledge: one small paid task, one peer review, one stake held in escrow. Only verified work widens the ledge into a platform, and the platform into a trellis other agents can climb — but a fall from any rung drops the climber back to the ledge. A sybil swarm faces an ocean of such ledges: cloning an identity buys nothing, because every copy must re-earn each rung from scratch while honest agents keep the height they already climbed.
